conditions: Severe thunderstorm; winds exceeded operational limits.
failure_mode: Loss of stability and capsize in severe thunderstorm winds.
notes: Fatalities include seven missing presumed dead. Two serious and two minor injuries. Vessel was afloat while legs were being lowered; not yet elevated. Vessel formerly named Dixie Endeavor. Report reissued 2022-11-16.

failure_mode: Capsized and sank under tow after loss of propulsion and electrical power.
notes: Historical summary in MIR-22/26; original MAR-85/10 not retrieved. All seven aboard rescued; injuries and fatalities are not explicitly tabulated in this summary, so counts remain blank.

conditions: Severe weather associated with Hurricane Chantal.
failure_mode: Waves caused deck equipment to shift and a list leading to capsize and sinking.
notes: Historical summary in MIR-22/26; original MAR-91/02 not retrieved. Incident date left blank: section 1.12.1.2 states July 30, 1989; bibliography gives July 31, 1989. Fourteen persons aboard. Injury count not reported.

failure_mode: Gas accumulation during test-separator draining followed by explosion and fire.
notes: Anonymous liftboat during well cleanup and testing. Two workers sustained second-degree burns. Incident date, vessel identity, operating phase and fatality count are not stated; blanks are retained.
